messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: HIGH - HarborTech dedicated VPC pool (tenant=harbortech) redaction pipeline failing. Unredacted PII present in forwarded logs to external retention. Incident ID HT-2026-03-15-1. Paging oncall @emma and SRE.
emma (oncall): acked. pulling incident runbook now. emma (oncall): cu for impact? is customer seeing outages or just data leak risk? olivia (cust-eng): HarborTech reports no service outage, only we're seeing unredacted payloads in the retention stream for eu-west-1. This is an enterprise tenant on dedicated pool dedicated-ht1, strict contract for redaction/retention. they opened support ref HT-842.
emma (oncall): ok. triage priority = contain data flow first. sanjay (sre): recommended immediate steps — isolate the pool, disable external log forwarding, snapshot current logs for legal review with strict ACL and TTL.
emma (oncall): sanjay do it. post commands you’ll run.
sanjay (sre): running isolation and stop-forwarding now. commands:
```
redwoodctl cluster isolate --tenant harbortech --pool dedicated-ht1
redwoodctl logging forward disable --tenant harbortech --target s3://harbortech-retention
```
Sanjay (sre): disabling forwarding... waiting for confirmation from infra.
devops-bot: run accepted. Task id run-7792. disabling forwarders for tenant harbortech...
devops-bot: forwarders disabled for harbortech. estimated in-flight buffer flush 30s.
emma (oncall): good. next: snapshot logs to a locked bucket + redact attempt before any human access. kai (platform): propose snapshot to encrypted bucket with ephemeral read-only creds, then run redaction job. commands:
```
redwoodctl logs snapshot --tenant harbortech --pool dedicated-ht1 --dest s3://temp-harbortech-snap-enc --encrypt KMS:rw-infra
redwoodctl jobs create --job redact --input s3://temp-harbortech-snap-enc --output s3://temp-harbortech-snap-redacted --script redact_v2.py
```
kai (platform): will create IAM role limited to job runner and log retention TTL 2h.
olivia (cust-eng): HarborTech requires all access logged + legal signoff before anyone can view raw. they also requested a chain-of-custody note. maria (legal): I need a short statement of scope + who will access and for how long. I can approve a 2-hour emergency access window for SRE if redaction attempt is run first and audit logs are captured. must delete raw snapshot after redaction and confirm deletion.
maria (legal): also need to know if anything was already shipped to external vendor or long-term retention. olivia (cust-eng): looks like some batches were forwarded yesterday to s3://harbortech-archive (external retention). estimating size ~12GB. sanjay (sre): checking forward history and will list objects. command:
```
redwoodctl logging forward list-objects --tenant harbortech --target s3://harbortech-archive --since 2026-03-14T00:00Z
```
Sanjay (sre): found 3 objects uploaded since yesterday, pulling manifest and isolating them from downstream consumers.
emma (oncall): copy of those objects should be moved to gated bucket and redaction attempted before any human read. do not grant raw read without maria signoff.
kai (platform): starting redact job now.
devops-bot: job redact-441 queued. running on dedicated cluster. progress: 0% -> 12% -> 47% -> 100%.
devops-bot: redact-441 complete. output at s3://temp-harbortech-snap-redacted. md5: abcdef1234. raw snapshot still present at s3://temp-harbortech-snap-enc (locked).
emma (oncall): can someone paste a small before/after sample (sanitized) so legal can confirm redaction criteria met? keep it tiny and mask real values.
sanjay (sre): sample BEFORE (from log line):
```
2026-03-15T01:23:11Z request_id=0x9a2 user_email=steve.h@harbortech.com customer_id=HT-451 ssn=123-45-6789 payload_size=842
```
sanjay (sre): sample AFTER (redact_v2):
```
2026-03-15T01:23:11Z request_id=0x9a2 user_email=****@harbortech.com customer_id=HT-451 ssn=REDACTED payload_size=842
```
maria (legal): thanks. that redaction pattern (mask email localpart, redact SSN tokens) looks acceptable. approve 2-hour limited access for sanjay and emma to verify full set, provided audit logging is enabled and raw snapshot deleted after verification. please post deletion receipts.
emma (oncall): granting minimal creds to sanjay for 2h. emma (oncall): sanjay please run verify script and post checksums.
sanjay (sre): running verification: `redwoodctl logs verify --input s3://temp-harbortech-snap-redacted --pattern ssn=REDACTED --count-only` -> result: matched 184 lines, all redacted. verification hash sha256: 0x7b9c...
olivia (cust-eng): informing HarborTech: we’ve isolated pool, stopped forwarding, ran redaction job, legal approved limited read to verify. ticket HT-842 updated. they asked for a short timeline and confirmation when raw data is deleted.
emma (oncall): planned next steps: 1) confirm deletes for s3://harbortech-archive copies 2) delete raw snapshot s3://temp-harbortech-snap-enc and post receipt 3) update HarborTech with timeline + mitigation 4) postmortem and long-term fixes (pipeline health checks + auto-redact gate).
emma (oncall): assigning follow-ups: sanjay = verification + delete; kai = harden redaction job + alerting; olivia = customer comms; maria = retention/legal closure. lucas (oncall-next): I’ll hand off at 02:00Z, will take over if any regressions after deletion.
sanjay (sre): deleting raw snapshot now. command: `aws s3 rm s3://temp-harbortech-snap-enc --recursive` -> deletion complete. receipt id del-2291. sha256 of redacted package retained: 0x7b9c...
emma (oncall): recorded deletion receipt. maria (legal): I confirm legal ack; please include this in the incident record and send the deletion proof to compliance mailbox. olivia (cust-eng): HarborTech notified and appreciative for quick containment. they requested follow-up on why redaction pipeline failed and a timeline for preventing recurrence.
emma (oncall): will open postmortem ticket and schedule action owner sync. closing this paging thread. :white_check_mark:
lucas (oncall-next): thanks team, I’m briefed and oncall takeover acknowledged.
